tools.name: New device setup (full build chain)
tools.description: McAfee removal, OEM debloat, M365 Apps reinstall, Chrome + Reader, hostname shortcut. Unattended.
tools.confirm: Runs the full build chain (15-30+ min) and REBOOTS the machine at the end.

prompts.prompt: Skip the automatic reboot at the end?
Skip the Hostname desktop shortcut?

tools.name: McAfee removal
tools.description: Strips Store, MSI and EXE McAfee preloads. Exit 3010 = removed, reboot.

tools.name: OEM debloat (HP / Dell)
tools.description: Removes OEM and consumer bloat, keeps SupportAssist / HP Support Assistant.

prompts.prompt: Dry run only (log what would go, change nothing)?
Force silent uninstall of EXE apps with no known silent switch?

tools.name: OEM drivers + BIOS (Dell / HP / Lenovo)
tools.description: Scans with the vendor's own updater (Dell Command Update, HP Image Assistant, Lenovo LSUClient), lists, asks, installs. Never restarts.

prompts.prompt: Include BIOS updates (plug the charger in)?

tools.name: M365 Apps reset + reinstall
tools.description: ODT removal of every Office install, optional Microsoft Get Help deep scrub, then a clean M365 Apps install.
tools.confirm: Removes ALL installed Office and reinstalls (3-4 GB download).

prompts.prompt: Licence type
Also run Microsoft's Get Help deep scrub (slower, for broken installs)?

tools.name: Chrome + Adobe Reader install
tools.description: Chrome Enterprise MSI + offline Reader, with Reader cloud/AI features locked down.

prompts.prompt: Install which

tools.name: Hostname desktop shortcut
tools.description: Desktop shortcut that shows the computer name. For "what's my PC called?" calls.

prompts.prompt: Put it on the Public desktop for all users (needs admin)?

tools.name: Driver export (before a wipe)
tools.description: Backs up every third-party driver with a manifest and restore note.

prompts.prompt: Export folder (blank = C:\DriverExport\<PC>_<model>_<date>)
Zip it into one file as well?

tools.name: Driver import (from an export)
tools.description: Installs every driver from a previous export folder or .zip with pnputil.

prompts.prompt: Export folder or .zip to install from

tools.name: Windows repair checks (DISM + SFC)
tools.description: DISM RestoreHealth, SFC /scannow, DISM component cleanup.

tools.name: Windows Update reset
tools.description: Stops update services, sets aside SoftwareDistribution and catroot2, restarts, rescans.
tools.confirm: Renames SoftwareDistribution and catroot2. Update history in Settings starts empty (installed updates stay).

prompts.prompt: Also reset Winsock (only if updates fail to download at all; needs reboot)?
Delete .old copies left by previous resets?

tools.name: Teams cache clear (new + classic)
tools.description: Closes Teams, empties the cache folder Microsoft documents (settings kept), starts Teams again. Run as the user.

prompts.prompt: Leave Teams closed afterwards?

tools.name: Print spooler clear
tools.description: Stops the spooler, deletes stuck jobs (.SPL/.SHD only), starts it again with its dependants.
tools.confirm: Deletes every queued print job on this PC - people will need to print again.

tools.name: Office activation reset
tools.description: Microsoft Get Help ResetOfficeActivation: clears Office licences and cached sign-ins so the user can activate fresh.
tools.confirm: Closes all Office apps and signs Office out. The user signs in again afterwards.

tools.name: Teams Meeting add-in fix (classic Outlook)
tools.description: Checks the add-in is installed and registered; fixes LoadBehavior, Outlook's disabled list and do-not-disable list. Run as the user.
tools.confirm: Closes classic Outlook if it needs to fix anything.

prompts.prompt: Check only (change nothing, leave Outlook open)?

tools.name: Quick triage (first five minutes)
tools.description: Device, uptime, reboot, disk, crashes, updates, AV, Entra/Intune and network on one page, problems first. Optional Wi-Fi + battery reports.

prompts.prompt: Write the one-page HTML report too?
Also save Windows' Wi-Fi + battery reports (Wi-Fi needs admin)?

tools.name: Entra / Intune health check
tools.description: Join state, PRT, MDM enrolment, certs, last check-in, IME, event errors, endpoints.

prompts.prompt: Trigger an Intune sync after the checks (needs admin)?
Bundle logs into a zip for escalation (needs admin)?

tools.name: BitLocker key backup check
tools.description: Is every recovery key backed up to Entra? Event 845/846 per key; -Fix backs up the missing ones. Never shows the keys.

prompts.prompt: Back up any keys that aren't proven backed up to Entra?

tools.name: Device inventory (hardware + OS)
tools.description: Model, serial, RAM sticks, disks and wear, monitors, battery, network, TPM.

prompts.prompt: Write an HTML report as well?

tools.name: Disk usage report (HTML)
tools.description: TreeSize-style scan: biggest folders, files and safe cleanup targets.

prompts.prompt: Path to scan (blank = system drive)

tools.name: Disk usage browser (GUI)
tools.description: Live folder-size browser. Look, don't touch: it can't delete anything.

tools.name: Event triage (GUI)
tools.description: Groups event log noise into what's actually wrong. Local or remote.

tools.name: M365 licence report (Excel)
tools.description: Graph-based user + licence workbook with reclaim and unlicensed sheets.

prompts.prompt: Tenant ID or domain (blank = pick at sign-in)
Client name for the filename (blank = tenant name)
Include last sign-in (needs AuditLog.Read.All)?
Install missing Graph / ImportExcel modules?

tools.name: Exchange + Planner usage report
tools.description: Who is licensed for Exchange / Planner but not using it. CSV + Excel.

prompts.prompt: Tenant domain, e.g. contoso.onmicrosoft.com
Connect via GDAP (partner access)?
Skip the Planner sign-in log scan (faster on big tenants)?
